milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to access Elder Hu's spirit fight and Dream Nail interactables

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit yields 100 Essence upon defeat; Elder Hu becomes aware of his mistake

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens

milestones.name: Enter Stone Sanctuary
milestones.note: Dark sub-area in southeast Greenpath, can be illuminated with Lumafly Lantern

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Green mossy area with Moss Knights, Aluba enemies, Quirrel and Unn as characters

zones.name: Stone Sanctuary
zones.note: Dark sub-area in southeast Greenpath filled with spike pits; resting place of Warrior Dream No Eyes; can be illuminated with Lumafly Lantern

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where the Love Key is found on a large dead Husk Dandy

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Location Elder Hu reached before being killed by the Mantis Tribe

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Elder Hu's memorial is located above the gates; his tunic and bead necklace rest on top of it

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit and to Dream Nail interactable objects/corpses; yields Essence from defeated spirits

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended (not required) for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable against Elder Hu in a Spell build strategy

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell usable against Elder Hu in a Spell build strategy

abilities.name: Shape of Unn
abilities.note: Point of interest listed in Greenpath

abilities.name: Shaman Stone
abilities.note: Charm recommended for Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Spell Twister
abilities.note: Charm recommended for Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Soul Catcher
abilities.note: Charm recommended for Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Soul Eater
abilities.note: Charm recommended for Spell build against Elder Hu

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Warrior Dream fought at his memorial above the gates to City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to access; has Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, and Teleport attacks; yields 100 Essence on defeat

bosses.name: No Eyes
bosses.note: Warrior Dream resting in Stone Sanctuary, southeast Greenpath

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire the Dream Nail, then travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears to initiate the fight
objectives.note: Dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; Shade Cloak recommended

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat Elder Hu's spirit with the Dream Nail equipped to absorb the released Essence

objectives.name: Obtain Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Find and interact with the large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens
objectives.note: Corpse can be Dream Nailed for dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Obtain Shape of Unn
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the Shape of Unn point of interest within Greenpath

objectives.name: Explore Stone Sanctuary
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast part of Greenpath; bring Lumafly Lantern to illuminate the dark spike-filled sub-area
objectives.note: Warrior Dream No Eyes is found here
